nodes.title: Junction Lantern
nodes.text: The glass is cold. Something it needs is missing.

nodes.title: Junction Lantern
nodes.text: You lift the crystal to the cold glass. For a moment nothing happens. Then the wick catches with a sound like a held breath let go, and the Lantern burns gold, green at its heart. [page] Warmth runs into your hands. The ache of the night loosens. Beside you, the old lamplighter is holding his breath.
